name: the forest
title: A Quiet Forest
description: Tall trunks, close together. The sea is only a sound now.
Trunks stand close and the light thins. Behind you, the sea is only a sound.
Among tall trees the air goes still. You can barely hear the sea.

text: Tall trunks, close together. The light is dim and green.

Trunks, moss, and a quiet that swallows the sea.
Dead branches lie among the roots, dry enough to burn.
Deadwood everywhere under the trees.

landmarks.label: the sound of water
text: Between mossy stones, a small spring. The water is clear and cold.
Water wells up between mossy stones: a spring, clear and cold.
You find where the sound comes from: a small spring among the stones. The water is clean.

landmarks.label: the small trails
text: Narrow trails wind through the undergrowth, too small for anything but rabbits. Droppings, fresh. A snare could take one.
In the morning light you see them: little paths through the ferns, worn by rabbits. Snares would catch them.
Low runs under the bracken, droppings along them. Rabbits. With cord you could set snares.
